action.question: Draft issues can't take comments. How should I record what's pending?

questions.question: Draft issues can't take comments. How should I record what's pending?

options.label: Append to body
options.description: Add a '## Pending' section to the draft issue's body listing what's left (push branch + run install.sh on prod/stage to deploy). Stays a draft, no new issue number, fully reversible.

options.label: Convert + comment
options.description: Convert the draft to a real GitHub issue (requires picking a repo, e.g. dstrader-aws — creates a permanent issue number & may notify), then post the pending note as an actual comment.
